title: Figurative and Cultural Knowledge in LLMs: Investigating Cross-Domain Transfer through Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2608.18361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Figurative language is deeply culturally embedded; fluent use requires not just linguistic competence but cultural immersion. We ask whether LLMs can learn this link: does fine-tuning on cultural data improve figurative language understanding, and vice versa? We conduct a systematic study across four models (ALLaM-7B, Fanar-1-9B, Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and six Arabic datasets spanning cultural commonsense, proverbs, and poetry across diverse dialects and regions. Fine-tuning on poetry improves idiom comprehension (+2.33%, p<0.05), a gain our ArabicMMLU control does not reproduce, indicating that it stems from figurative content rather than Arabic language adaptation and pointing to a sensitivity to non-literal meaning that transfers across figurative types. translated_title: 大语言模型中的比喻与文化知识：通过微调探究跨领域迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18361v1 公告类型：新 摘要：比喻语言深深植根于文化之中；流利使用不仅需要语言能力，还需要文化沉浸。我们探究大语言模型能否学习这种联系：对文化数据进行微调是否能提升比喻语言理解，反之亦然？我们在四个模型（ALLaM-7B、Fanar-1-9B、Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B）和六个涵盖不同方言与地区的阿拉伯语数据集（涉及文化常识、谚语和诗歌）上进行了系统性研究。对诗歌进行微调能提升习语理解（+2.33%，p<0.05），而我们的阿拉伯语MMLU对照组未能复现这一提升，表明这种增益源于比喻内容而非阿拉伯语语言适应，并指向一种跨比喻类型迁移的非字面意义敏感性。相比之下，文化微调降低了两个以阿拉伯语为中心的模型的谚语解读准确性。两个领域之间的迁移在其他情况下与噪声无异。
tldr: 本研究发现对诗歌数据进行微调能显著提升大语言模型的习语理解能力，且这种提升源于比喻内容本身而非语言适应，但文化微调反而损害了谚语理解，表明比喻知识迁移存在特定方向性。
en_tdlr: This study finds that fine-tuning on poetry significantly improves LLM idiom comprehension, with gains stemming from figurative content rather than language adaptation, while cultural fine-tuning harms proverb interpretation, revealing directional transfer of figurative knowledge.
